audio_seconds_basis: exact wav header value (frames / sample rate), rounded to 9 decimals; the tier manifest records duration to 3 decimals and is cross-checked to that precision (tolerance 1e-3 s)
flight_split_identity_hash_convention: data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6> -- the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and an exposure row for a FlightRuntime flight of this roster must carry

documented_exception.explanation: generation_results.csv there names 25 speaker filenames, none of which is either wav the release ships in that directory; the internal loader would resolve no audio and skip the query, while the released manifest is unambiguous. The manifest is treated as authoritative, so the population is the full 2,146

official_rule_audit.method: replay of audio_benchmark/datasets/tier1_dataset.py::_get_audio_paths (only_successful=True, speakers_per_query=1, stale-absolute-path fallback to query_dir/<basename>) at commit b9d5383ca30945fbafb965a04bea40117e1e8a82
official_rule_audit.note: the released generation_results.csv files carry the authors' internal /data2/... absolute paths, so the loader's documented stale-path fallback is the branch that fires on any public copy; on every directory but the recorded exception it selects exactly the manifest's lowest-id (lowest speaker_idx) row

population.rule: the released benchmark's own tier-1 population: for each of the 2146 query_* directories in sorted order, the FIRST successful speaker, which on the public v1.0 release is the shipped speaker with the lowest speaker_idx (the manifest row with the lowest id)
population.why_not_max_samples: the release orders every subset smart_home -> wearables -> smart_car (its own README), so max_samples 500 over sorted query directories would be a pure smart_home sample; the draw below is uniform over all 2,146

selection.algorithm: random.Random(seed).sample(population, count), where population is the official first-speaker rows in ascending manifest id order (identical to sorted query-directory order)
selection.rule: uniform without replacement over the whole tier-1 official population

split_identity_hash_convention: sha256 over the LF-joined sorted 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>, UTF-8, no trailing newline) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention
